title: When your writing wobbles, listen for what AI echoes
headings: Slow AI #1 – Teach It Something It Cannot Know
coverage: opening + one cue-ranked passage + headings; partial inspection

passages.text: There is a moment in every project when you can feel the wobble.
Instead of piling on more polish, we ask: what if you let AI write the chapter you can feel, but cannot yet see?
